address: 2F, 688 Plaza, 688 West Nanjing Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: The seafood stall by the entrance lets diners make their own choices from the items shipped directly from Taizhou that day. Seasonality is key and that determines exactly which ingredients will be used in certain dishes. Customers can also specify how they want their seafood cooked. The restaurant communicates with every customer before their visit; consider pre-ordering signatures such as braised yellow croaker or golden deep-fried hairtail....
